content.title: Lane ADU- Major Modification for Driveway Material
content.summary: The Lane ADU project involves a major modification for driveway material at 6800 W 55th Ave, where a detached garage and accessory dwelling unit will be constructed behind an existing single-family home. The new structure will include a garage, storage, a bedroom, and a kitchen/shower, with access from the current driveway. Public hearings with the Planning Commission are scheduled for June 17, 2026, with a City Council hearing to be determined.

![Site plan for major modification](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7606)

## DA2026-0035

### **Project Name:** Lane ADU- Major Modification for Driveway Material

- **Address/Location:**6800 W 55th Ave
- **Developer:**n/a
- **Planner:**Chris Sandine
- **Acres:** .34
- **Use:** Residential
- **Total Units:** N/A
- **Planning Commission Public Hearing:**June 17, 2026
- **City Council Public Hearing:**TBD

**Project Narrative from the Developer:**The project is a detached Garage / Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) at the rear of an existing single-family lot at 6800 W. 55th Ave. The existing primary residence remains. The new structure includes a garage, storage, bedroom, and kitchen/shower, accessed from the existing driveway off W. 55th Ave. A reference image of the site is provided on the following page.
